claim_under_test: Current WP807 evaluate_agentic_core can return SUPPORTED_AT_COMPONENT_SCOPE for a complete accepted four-capability evidence bundle whose total success_count is zero, provided submitted intervention/delta/sample predicates pass.
source_semantics_observed: CapabilityEvidence validates success_count only as an integer between zero and sample_count.
evaluate_agentic_core gates completeness, ACCEPTED source state, distinct receipt/reconciliation hashes, shared holdout_set_id, sample floor, intervention-score floor and delta-over-baseline floor.
evaluate_agentic_core does not gate on success_count.
total_success_count is computed only after verdict logic and carried into AgenticCoreReport without a nonzero-success acceptance invariant.

execution_note.method: A deterministic local semantic harness copied the exact acceptance predicates visible in the bound WP807 source text and evaluated the witness above.
execution_note.important_limit: The private repository blob could not be imported directly into the local execution container through the available connector/raw-download boundary. Therefore this is an exact-source semantic witness, not direct byte-for-byte module execution and not F2 runtime evidence.

result.interpretation: WP807's current component-support verdict can be decoupled from explicit success/completion evidence. This does not prove upstream WP802-WP805 scores are wrong; it proves WP807 itself does not enforce or verify their relationship to success_count.
result.recommended_fail_closed_repair: Require producer-bound score derivation or recompute accepted score from bound raw results, and require explicit completion/success consistency before any supported verdict. Preserve component-only authority wording.

counterhypothesis.statement: Upstream producer contracts guarantee intervention_score_ppm is mathematically impossible to be high when success_count is zero, making the missing WP807 gate redundant.
counterhypothesis.next_discriminator: Trace exact accepted WP802-WP805 score-producer contracts and prove score/success derivation identities. Until then WP807 must not assume the invariant.
